provenance: Handwritten synthetic English/Russian/Bulgarian meaning-preservation pairs. These are judge-calibration inputs, not watermarked model outputs or proof of complete semantic coverage.
history: The first 8B critic saw development pairs before held-out pairs. The held-out partition is now public development evidence, not a fresh holdout for future tuning. Residency/citizenship pairs were added after a separate generated candidate exposed that confusion. Visitor/tourist and child-age cases were added after a full-document 27B judge missed category narrowing, despite accepting or rejecting the earlier short calibration pairs correctly. The mobility positive was clarified to retain the reader category after a label review exposed its broader people wording. Duration-expansion and omitted-supervision pairs were added after the independent AliMark trial. Earlier measurements refer to their archived input hash and do not evaluate this revision. Split place-name and owner/employee pairs were added after the Q64 AliMark sentence trial exposed these failures. They are examined development cases, not fresh holdout. Supplied-object roles, cleanup timing, plan realization and optional-demonstration pairs were added after the stronger-inserter PostMark trial exposed these failures. They are handwritten examined development evidence, not fresh held-out measurements. Resource availability/abundance pairs were added after reviewing the accepted MLX follow-up. Season loss/range and maintenance/visit frequency pairs were added after the selected AutoMark trial exposed these issues. These handwritten examined cases are not a fresh holdout; the season guard does not establish preservation of daily/occasional frequency or full event binding. Reopening, oldest-harvest and visitor-beneficiary pairs were added after the visible-names experiment produced more complete but factually changed outputs. These are examined development cases, not a new holdout or proof that the default fact checker catches them. Russian whole/scaled cardinal, bound and duration-adjective pairs were added after reviewing unsupported spelled quantities. These are examined regression evidence. The earlier English-only MiniCheck trial refers to its archived input hash and does not evaluate these added pairs. Whole English cardinal, signed/exponent value, literal-address and whole-bound-binding pairs were added after numeric-parser regressions. These are examined synthetic regression cases. Earlier NLI, LLM and MiniCheck results refer to their archived input hashes, not this revised corpus. Scheduling certainty, intended allocation versus dispatch, explicit visitor/staff instruction roles and during-versus-throughout pairs were added after a pinned Qwen3.5-9B MLX trial exposed meaning changes. These short handwritten pairs disambiguate the observed failure types. They are examined development evidence, not a fresh holdout. Earlier judge measurements do not cover this revised corpus or its added Bulgarian cases. Selected unit, unit/value/bound binding and Russian duration-unit pairs were added after adjacent-measurement regressions. A measurement-role pair records a fresh unmarked default-model precision invention despite intact units. These are examined development cases, not held-out evidence or a complete semantic guarantee; earlier judge metrics do not evaluate this revised hash. Alternate-day recurrence and invented weekly scheduling pairs were added after the exact FreshRace/RenewalRace source-state cohort returned detector-negative but meaning-changed prose. These are examined synthetic development cases. Earlier judge results refer to their archived corpus hashes and do not evaluate this revision. Indefinite English duration and conditional-light pairs were added after a native recurrence-guard follow-up still dropped the source's for-a-day condition. These are examined synthetic development cases; previous judge measurements remain bound to their archived corpus hashes. Bare-number multiplicity, frequency-to-event binding and resident/tool provenance pairs were added after paired native 9B rewrite experiments exposed duplicate numbers and role/scope changes. These are examined, disambiguated synthetic development cases, not fresh holdout measurements; ambiguous model wording is not treated as a definite binary-label contradiction. Earlier judge results remain bound to their archived corpus hashes. Added examined English/Russian approval, responsibility and permission development counterparts after native Qwen3-4B observations. Earlier judge measurements remain bound to their earlier corpus hash; these additions are not an independent holdout. Added examined honorific/surname and initials development counterparts after a native ChoirMark output lost a surname. These are not new held-out judge measurements.
